finalists.label: Frontal Lobe Epilepsy
finalists.why: rhythmic epileptiform discharges originating from the right frontal area with ipsilateral hemispheric spreading and relatively limited homologous contralateral involvement.

finalists.label: Epilepsy
finalists.why: episodes of prominent dizziness, vertigo, intermittent left arm shaking, and bouts of dull response, along with rhythmic epileptiform discharges originating from the right frontal area.

finalists.label: Vasovagal Syncope
finalists.why: episodes of prominent dizziness, vertigo, intermittent left arm shaking, and bouts of dull response, although the high blood pressure at triage is not typical for this condition.

frontier_selector.why: the presence of rhythmic epileptiform discharges originating from the right frontal area specifically supports Frontal Lobe Epilepsy over the more general Epilepsy.
